scope: Static review of the reporting-only partial Bifrost v0.14.0 to v0.14.4 comparison helper and its imported sealed audit primitives. No full case audit, analyzer, build, or controller was run.

initial_findings_and_resolution.resolution: The successor pins the full-audit helper SHA-256 before importing it and records its own and imported helper hashes in the generated result.

The successor pins the target contract and checks each present target row's source commit, plan commit, contract hash, exact runtime argv, expected group case IDs, and BIFROST_OPEN_PACKS_DISABLE=1 before classifying it.

verified: Only completed groups are normalized and compared. Non-completed receipts are retained as incomplete records without scoring their partial captures; absent groups are recorded as not-started.
Target ledger rows must be unique by group and belong to the 20 baseline groups. The original 109-row ledger prefix must match the sealed baseline hash.

Completed rows must match their completed.json receipt, have one report, and match the staged report hash. Imported primitives verify captured report and raw-case hashes; compared case IDs and fixture revisions are checked against the baseline.

The completed paired-row count plus all failed and missing expected rows must equal the full 1116-row denominator. The output keeps partial distinct fixture count separate from the fixed full-run values of 1000 Bifrost fixtures and 1108 population fixtures.
The original strict full-20 audit helper is byte-pinned by the new helper and remains unchanged in the worktree; its 20-of-20 gate is not relaxed.
The helper source compiles via in-memory compile(), and its --help path exits successfully without opening the ledger or starting an engine.
limitations: Validation predicates use Python assert statements. Run only with the standard interpreter and optimization disabled; python -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE would remove those checks.
The 1000 and 1108 full-run counts are emitted as fixed values from the pinned prior full audit; this partial helper does not derive them from its incomplete subset.
This receipt reviews source only. It does not certify the live partial audit, terminal smoke or TypeScript groups, full-target completion, performance, or release readiness.

validation.source_ownership: Only this assigned review receipt was written by the reviewer.

conclusion: The reviewed source is suitable for a read-only partial comparison under a standard non-optimized Python interpreter. Full comparison claims remain deferred until all target groups are terminal and the separate audit is run.
